findings.comment: Cache entries are stored without a TTL, so a stale profile is served until the process restarts.

finding_contract.current_impact: Users see a stale profile until the next deploy.
finding_contract.falsifiable_condition: Update a profile and reload within the hour.
finding_contract.headline: Cache entries never expire
